summaries.zh: GitHub 项目 "petergyang/no-ai-slop" 是一个基于 Python 的工具，旨在从文本中清除超过 20 种常见的 AI 生成内容模式（AI slop）。该项目广受关注，目前已获得 8606 个 Star 和 647 个 Fork，能够有效优化文本质量。
summaries.en: The GitHub repository "petergyang/no-ai-slop" is a Python-based tool designed to refine writing by removing over 20 specific patterns of "AI slop." The project has gained significant popularity on the platform, accumulating 8,606 stars and 647 forks.
